articles.title: Nathally Alves: Brasileira morta nos EUA ganha homenagem no Rio | G1
articles.standfirst: Nathally Alves tinha 20 anos e havia se mudado para os Estados Unidos em janeiro deste ano. Antes da mudança, a jovem morava na Ilha do Governador, Zona Norte do Rio.
articles.summary: Nathally Alves, de 20 anos, morreu em acidente de patinete elétrico na Flórida; amigos e familiares realizaram orações e soltaram balões em tributo na Ilha do Governador.
articles.body:
A jovem brasileira que morreu ao atravessar uma rua com patinete elétrico em Orlando , nos Estados Unidos, ganhou uma homenagem de amigos e familiares na tarde deste quarta-feira (9), na Ilha do Governador, Zona Norte do Rio.

Nathally Alves tinha 20 anos e, antes de se mudar para os Estados Unidos, em janeiro deste ano, morava na Ilha do Governador.

Durante a homenagem, amigos fizeram orações, soltaram balões e realizaram queima de fogos de artifícios.

Nesta quarta, também ocorrerá o velório de Nathally, na Flórida.

Nathally Alves tinha 20 anos e havia se mudado para os Estados Unidos em janeiro deste ano — Foto: Acervo pessoal/Claudia Ribeiro

De acordo com Cláudia Ribeiro, tia da vítima, a jovem foi atropelada por um veículo logo após sair do condomínio em que morava, na Flórida. Nathally estava usando patinete elétrico e estava indo buscar a irmã mais nova no colégio quando o acidente ocorreu.

"É uma dor gigante, uma tristeza sem fim. Nossa família está muito abalada. Ela estava indo buscar a irmã na escola de patinete elétrico, quando ia atravessar pela faixa de pedestre. Uma testemunha fala que o sinal estava verde, mas meu irmão disse que ela só atravessava no sinal. Na verdade, não temos explicação de como foi", comentou Cláudia.

articles.title: Ivan Moraes, candidato ao Governo de PE, participa de sabatina | G1
articles.standfirst: O Diálogo com os Candidatos, projeto do Grupo Asa Branca, promoveu sabatina. O objetivo é apresentar aos eleitores informações sobre as propostas e posicionamentos dos candidatos em temas considerados relevantes para o desenvolvimento de Pernambuco.
articles.summary: O objetivo é apresentar aos eleitores informações sobre as propostas e posicionamentos dos candidatos em temas considerados relevantes para o desenvolvimento de Pernambuco.
articles.body:
Ivan Moraes, do PSOL, participa de sabatina do Grupo Asa Branca — Foto: Fábio Gomes/g1 Caruaru

Nesta quarta-feira (9), o Grupo Asa Branca promoveu o Diálogo com os Candidatos - Eleições 2026. O segundo a participar do projeto foi Ivan Moraes (PSOL), candidato ao Governo de Pernambuco. A sabatina foi dividida em quatro blocos e teve transmissão ao vivo por meio das redes sociais da CBN Caruaru e CNF, veículos que integram o Grupo Asa Branca.

A iniciativa é organizada por entidades representativas da classe empresarial e pela Ordem dos Advogados do Brasil (OAB) - Subseção Caruaru, com o objetivo de apresentar aos eleitores informações sobre as propostas e posicionamentos dos candidatos em temas considerados relevantes para o desenvolvimento de Pernambuco.

A mediação foi feita pelo jornalista Magno Wendel. Representantes da Associação Comercial e Empresarial de Caruaru (Acic), Federação das Associações Comerciais e Empresariais de Pernambuco (Facep), Federação das Indústrias do Estado de Pernambuco (Fiepe), Câmara de Dirigentes Lojistas de Caruaru (CDL Caruaru), Sindicato dos Lojistas do Comércio de Caruaru (Sindloja) e da OAB Caruaru, além dos analistas políticos Ney Lima e Elielson Lima, colunistas da CBN Caruaru.

Os candidatos ao Governo de Pernambuco respondem perguntas sobre:

Infraestrutura e capacidade de investimento do Estado;

A transmissão completa do Diálogo com os Candidatos pode ser conferida clicando aqui .

No primeiro bloco, o candidato ao Governo de Pernambuco, Ivan Moraes, teve 10 minutos para se apresentar. O jornalista Magno Wendel explicou a dinâmica da sabatina.

O primeiro a fazer a pergunta foi Michel Jean, presidente do Sindloja, com tema de infraestrutura. Na oportunidade, o candidato foi questionado sobre as propostas para a BR-232, rodovia que corta do interior até a capital do estado.

Ivânia Porto, representante da Acic e da Facepe, fez uma pergunta direcionada à temática do emprego e renda. João Bezerra, diretor da Fiepe, foi sorteado com o tema a respeito de cultura e turismo. Gustavo Melo, diretor da CDL, perguntou ao candidato sobre a capacidade de investimento.

No terceiro bloco de perguntas dos representantes das entidades, Ivânia Porto fez uma pergunta com a temática de educação. João Bezerra fez uma pergunta sobre economia. Gustavo Melo fez uma pergunta sobre segurança. Michel Jean finalizou o bloco fazendo uma pergunta sobre a temática de saúde.

O último bloco foi direcionado a perguntas dos colunistas políticos, com direito a réplica e tréplica. Os temas das perguntas foram livres. Elielson Lima fez uma pergunta em relação a questão da saúde, direcionada ao quesito do aborto, que está previsto no plano de governo do candidato. Na réplica, o jornalista fez uma pergunta direcionada a educação sexual para os jovens nas escolas.

O colunista Ney Lima direcionou a pergunta para a questão da tarifa zero para os usuários do transporte público. Na réplica, o colunista questionou novamente sobre o tema da mobilidade e as tarifas entre as empresas de transporte coletivo.

Em seguida, Elielson Lima fez uma nova pergunta sobre como o estado vai regular o desvio do plantio da cannabis. O plantio da planta está dentro do plano de governo do candidato, com foco no uso medicinal. Na réplica, Elielson questionou como será feita a regulamentação do plantio da cannabis.

Ney Lima também teve a oportunidade de perguntar sobre como funcionaria o fim da escala 6x1. O candidato havia dito que não contrataria empresas que adotam a escala 6x1, caso seja eleito. Durante a réplica, Ney Lima direcionou uma nova pergunta sobre o plano de governo direcionada para cultura.

articles.title: Saiba de onde pode estar vindo a fumaça que encobre Manaus | G1
articles.standfirst: Dados do Instituto Nacional de Pesquisas Espaciais registraram focos de calor no Amazonas e em estados vizinhos; órgãos ambientais apontam diferentes áreas como possíveis fontes da fumaça.
articles.summary: Dados do Inpe registraram focos de calor no Amazonas e em estados vizinhos; órgãos ambientais apontam diferentes áreas como possíveis fontes da fumaça.
articles.body:
Imagens de satélite registraram focos de queimadas em diferentes áreas do Amazonas e de estados vizinhos que podem estar relacionados à fumaça que encobre Manaus nesta quarta-feira (9) . Os dados são do satélite GOES-19, divulgados pelo Programa Queimadas do Instituto Nacional de Pesquisas Espaciais (Inpe). Até às 15h, foram identificados 582 focos de calor no Amazonas .

🔎 Focos de calor são pontos identificados por satélites que apresentam temperatura mais alta do que as áreas ao redor e podem indicar a ocorrência de queimadas. No entanto, cada foco não corresponde necessariamente a um incêndio, já que o mesmo fogo pode gerar mais de um registro e outras fontes de calor também podem ser detectadas pelos satélites.

A origem da fumaça, no entanto, ainda não é apontada de forma única pelas fontes consultadas pelo g1 . Pesquisadores e órgãos ambientais citam diferentes áreas como possíveis responsáveis pelo material que chegou à capital.

Segundo o pesquisador Rodrigo Augusto Ferreira de Souza, da Universidade do Estado do Amazonas (UEA), a fumaça registrada em Manaus está fortemente relacionada às queimadas na Região Metropolitana de Manaus.

O governo do Amazonas, por meio da Defesa Civil, informou que a fumaça registrada na capital está relacionada a focos de incêndio em Manaus, incluindo áreas do Coroado e do Conjunto Canaranas, além de ocorrências em municípios da Região Metropolitana e áreas próximas.

Nesta quarta-feira, o monitoramento do órgão apontou média de 35 µg/m³ de material particulado (PM 2,5) nas últimas 24 horas, também indicando qualidade do ar moderada. A qualidade do ar é considerada boa quando a concentração de partículas fica entre 0 e 25 µg/m³.

Já a Prefeitura de Manaus afirma que a fumaça também pode estar vindo de áreas de queimadas ao sul do Amazonas, no norte de Mato Grosso e em Rondônia. De acordo com a administração municipal, o material particulado está sendo transportado para a capital pela circulação dos ventos em baixos níveis da atmosfera.

A prefeitura relaciona a mudança no comportamento dos ventos ao avanço de uma frente fria pelo Centro-Sul do país. O fenômeno teria alterado temporariamente o padrão de circulação atmosférica e favorecido o transporte da fumaça em direção a Manaus.

A fumaça começou a ser percebida com mais intensidade em Manaus na manhã de terça-feira (8) . Na ocasião, a qualidade do ar foi classificada como moderada, e moradores relataram cheiro de fumaça em diferentes bairros da capital.

Veja quais municípios tiveram mais focos no Amazonas

No Amazonas, os focos estão espalhados por diferentes municípios. Apuí lidera, com 117 registros, seguido por Lábrea , com 101. Na sequência aparecem Autazes , Novo Aripuanã , Careiro da Várzea , Manacapuru , Itacoatiara , Borba , Humaitá e Caapiranga . Veja lista completa abaixo:

Esses dez municípios concentram 510 dos 582 focos registrados no estado , o equivalente a 87,6% do total.

Apesar da quantidade de focos, os dados de satélite, isoladamente, não permitem afirmar que a fumaça que encobriu Manaus tenha vindo de um município específico . A direção e a velocidade dos ventos, a intensidade das queimadas e as condições atmosféricas precisam ser consideradas para determinar a possível trajetória da fumaça.

Satélite registra focos em estados vizinhos

Os dados do Inpe mostram que, além do Amazonas, outros estados da região também registraram focos de calor nesta quarta-feira.

Entre os estados vizinhos ao Amazonas, o Pará concentra o maior número de registros, com 942 focos. Rondônia teve 186, Mato Grosso, 106, Acre, 36, e Roraima, 19.

Somados, os seis estados registraram 1.871 focos de calor no levantamento.

A Secretaria de Estado de Saúde do Amazonas (SES-AM) orienta a população a reduzir a exposição à fumaça e evitar atividades que possam agravar sintomas respiratórios.

A recomendação é evitar atividades físicas e a permanência prolongada em ambientes externos enquanto houver fumaça. Sempre que possível, a população deve permanecer em locais fechados, manter portas e janelas fechadas nos períodos de maior concentração e utilizar máscara adequada, principalmente pessoas mais sensíveis aos efeitos da poluição do ar.

Crianças, idosos, gestantes e pessoas com doenças respiratórias ou cardiovasculares devem receber atenção especial e reduzir ainda mais a exposição.

A SES-AM orienta que pessoas com sintomas como falta de ar, chiado no peito, tosse persistente, dor ou aperto no peito, tontura ou mal-estar procurem uma unidade de saúde. Em situações de emergência, a orientação é acionar o Serviço de Atendimento Móvel de Urgência (Samu), pelo número 192.

articles.title: Operação cumpre mandados contra suspeitos de fraude em MG | G1
articles.standfirst: Segundo o MPMG, duas empresas de Além Paraíba teriam vencido licitações de forma sistemática em Laranjal. Servidores públicos também são investigados.
articles.summary: Segundo o MPMG, duas empresas de Além Paraíba teriam vencido licitações de forma sistemática em Laranjal. Servidores públicos também são investigados.
articles.body:
Seis mandados de busca e apreensão foram cumpridos em Laranjal e Muriaé . A ação aconteceu nesta quarta-feira (9) e marca a terceira fase da Operação Cavalo de Troia.

Segundo o Ministério Público de Minas Gerais (MPMG), a investigação apura possíveis fraudes em licitações e outras irregularidades envolvendo a administração pública de Laranjal.

Dos seis mandados, quatro foram cumpridos em Laranjal e dois em Muriaé. Conforme o MPMG, a operação busca reunir novas provas sobre um possível esquema envolvendo empresas que venceram procedimentos licitatórios no município, além de servidores públicos que teriam recebido transferências financeiras dos investigados.

Os nomes das empresas, dos envolvidos e os alvos dos mandados de busca e apreensão não foram informados.

O g1 entrou em contato com a Prefeitura de Laranjal para pedir posicionamento sobre o caso, mas não havia obtido retorno até a última atualização da reportagem.

Empresas de Além Paraíba são investigadas

As investigações começaram depois que a Promotoria de Justiça de Muriaé identificou que duas empresas sediadas em Além Paraíba venceram, de forma recorrente, licitações e outros procedimentos em Laranjal a partir de 2024.

De acordo com o MPMG, uma das empresas venceu dois chamamentos públicos para administrar a casa de repouso para idosos e o Hospital Municipal de Laranjal.

O Ministério Público afirma ter identificado indícios de que os atestados de capacidade técnica apresentados pela empresa continham informações falsas. Também foi constatado que a atividade econômica cadastrada da empresa, o CNAE, foi alterada dias antes da abertura de cada processo seletivo.

A segunda empresa investigada, também sediada em Além Paraíba, teria criado uma sede fictícia em Laranjal para participar de licitações que exigiam que as empresas contratadas estivessem localizadas próximas ao município.

Segundo o MPMG, essa empresa participou de processos para fornecimento de materiais e produtos diversos, como material de escritório, caixas d'água, gêneros alimentícios e drone pulverizador.

Os atestados de capacidade técnica apresentados por essa segunda empresa teriam sido fornecidos pela primeira. Ainda segundo o Ministério Público, os representantes legais das duas empresas mantêm relacionamento afetivo.

Para a investigação, os elementos levantados indicam a possibilidade de atuação conjunta para fraudar os procedimentos licitatórios.

Suspeita de superfaturamento e notas fiscais falsas

O MPMG também identificou indícios de superfaturamento e de emissão de notas fiscais falsas.

A suspeita é de que parte dos produtos pagos pela Prefeitura de Laranjal não tenha sido efetivamente entregue.

As informações ainda são objeto de investigação e, até o momento, não há condenação dos envolvidos.

Servidores públicos também estão entre investigados

Após analisar informações bancárias dos investigados, o MPMG identificou transferências de dinheiro feitas pelas empresas para três servidores públicos municipais e familiares deles.

Entre os investigados estão o assessor jurídico responsável pela emissão de pareceres em licitações, o servidor responsável pelos processos licitatórios do município e um secretário municipal.

Segundo o Ministério Público, os companheiros desses servidores também receberam valores em suas contas bancárias e foram incluídos entre os alvos dos mandados cumpridos.

A primeira fase da Operação Cavalo de Troia foi realizada em abril, quando foram cumpridos mandados de busca e apreensão em Laranjal e Além Paraíba. Em julho, durante a segunda fase, outro mandado de busca e apreensão foi cumprido em Além Paraíba.

Segundo o MPMG, caso os indícios sejam confirmados, os envolvidos poderão ser denunciados por crimes como fraude em licitações, associação criminosa e lavagem de capitais.

articles.title: Lanchonete serve hot dog 'descontruído' e na marmita em Jundiaí | G1
articles.standfirst: Formato alternativo foi inspirado em lanchonetes de Osasco (SP). O local também disponibiliza uma opção vegana produzida com falafel.
articles.summary: Uma lanchonete de Jundiaí (SP) serve cachorro-quente, mas não da forma que todos já estão acostumados: o lanche "desconstruído" é ervido na marmita.
articles.body:
Uma lanchonete de Jundiaí (SP) serve opções de cachorro-quente, mas não da forma que todos já estão acostumados. Ao invés de usar as mãos para comer, o cachorro-quente "desconstruído" do estabelecimento é servido na marmita e consumido com garfo e faca.

Nesta quarta-feira (9) é celebrado o Dia do Cachorro-Quente , lanche que passou por diversas modificações no Brasil, sendo servido com muito mais ingredientes do que a versão tradicional norte-americana ou alemã.

No Brasil, o pão não é recheado apenas com salsicha, ketchup e mostarda, mas também com purê de batata, milho, ervilha, frango (em alguns casos), batata palha, bacon e diversos outros adicionais. A lanchonete de Jundiaí decidiu usar essa versatilidade e servir tudo isso em um único prato de marmita.

Lanchonete de Jundiaí (SP) serve cachorro-quente, mas não da forma que todos já estão acostumados e sim na marmita — Foto: TV TEM/Reprodução

A forma alternativa de comer cachorro-quente foi inspirada nas lanchonetes de Osasco (SP), segundo a proprietária Mariana Pereira.

"É uma coisa (receita) muito tradicional de Osasco, que é uma das cidades que mais vende cachorro-quente no Brasil e no mundo, e eu resolvi trazer para Jundiaí, e eu trouxe muita visibilidade porque temos muitos pedidos no almoço, no jantar, as pessoas adoram muito mesmo", afirmou.

Forma alternativa de comer cachorro-quente em Jundiaí (SP) foi inspirada nas lanchonetes de Osasco (SP), segundo a proprietária Mariana Pereira — Foto: TV TEM/Reprodução

A lanchonete também tem uma opção de cachorro-quente para clientes veganos, com o lanche feito com falafel, bolinho frito ou assado de grão-de-bico misturado com ervas frescas e especiarias orientais.

O lanche segue o padrão dos cachorros-quentes comuns, sendo recheado com o purê, molhos, batata palha e seguindo para ser prensado na chapa.

Artur Pereira, um dos proprietários, afirmou que o falafel também pode ser feito em formato de salsicha, para ficar ainda mais parecido com o tradicional.

"Hot dogs veganos também estão crescendo e são feitos com falafel de grão-de-bico com especiarias. É uma comida típica árabe, então, a gente coloca ele no lanche e faz a receita de Jundiaí", afirmou.

articles.title: Mormaço Cultural 2026 começa com programação gratuita em Boa Vista | G1
articles.standfirst: Primeira etapa do festival ocorre no Teatro Municipal, com shows gratuitos de música, dança e teatro. Ingressos para espetáculos na área interna devem ser retirados na bilheteria.
articles.summary: Primeira etapa do festival ocorre no Teatro Municipal, com shows gratuitos de música, dança e teatro. Ingressos para espetáculos na área interna devem ser retirados na bilheteria.
articles.body:
Primeira etapa do Mormaço Cultural 2026 ocorre no Teatro Municipal de Boa Vista. — Foto: Diane Sampaio/PMBV

A 5ª edição do festival Mormaço Cultural 2026 começa nesta quarta-feira (9), em Boa Vista , com uma programação gratuita de música e dança no Teatro Municipal de Boa Vista. A primeira etapa do evento segue até o próximo domingo (13).

A noite de abertura tem início às 19h , na área externa do teatro, com apresentação de pop e rock do cantor Denison Siqueira . Em seguida, às 20h, o coletivo roraimense de cantoras "Som das Manas" faz o show principal, na Sala Roraimeira, que fica na área interna do Teatro.

Para assistir ao espetáculo principal desta quarta, o público precisa retirar o ingresso a partir das 19h , na bilheteria do Teatro Municipal. A organização vai distribuir 1.100 entradas gratuitas , com limite de um bilhete por pessoa.

O "Som das Manas" reúne as cantoras Ana Lu , Ana Gabriela , Euterpe , Leka Denz e Lionella Edwards . O grupo surgiu em março deste ano com o objetivo de fortalecer o trabalho de mulheres na cena musical de Roraima.

🎭 🎶 Como ocorre em todos os anos, o evento terá programação gratuita distribuída no Teatro Municipal e nos palcos Sol e Lua, no Parque do Rio Branco, no Centro da capital, a partir do dia 18, até o dia 20. Veja os horários dos shows nacionais no fim da reportagem .

Confira a programação da 1ª etapa do Mormaço 2026*:

19h às 20h - Denison Siqueira (área externa)

19h às 20h - Rubinho Gleydson (área externa)

20h - Focus Cia de Dança (sala Roraimeira)

11h - Focus Cia de Dança (sala Roraimeira)

*Toda a programação da 1ª etapa ocorre no Teatro Municipal de Boa Vista

A 5ª edição do Mormaço Cultural 2026 ocorre de 9 a 20 de setembro. Neste ano, o festival terá shows de Seu Jorge , Amado Batista , Cidade Negra , Fresno , Kevin o Chris , Melody , Ferrugem , Dennis , Filipe Ret e Cat Deadlers , além de artistas locais.

O evento também terá apresentações do grupo infantil Bolofofos durante o Mormaçinho, programação dedicada ao público infantil, e da Focus Cia de Dança, companhia de dança contemporânea do Rio de Janeiro. O chef de cozinha francês Olivier Anquier também participará do festival.

Este ano, a ideia é que nos 12 dias de programação, o público tenha acesso a shows locais e nacionais, apresentações de dança, teatro, circo, literatura, artes visuais, audiovisual, gastronomia, manifestações das comunidades tradicionais, economia criativa, atividades infantis e outras iniciativas.

articles.title: Apple lança o iPhone Duo, seu 1º celular dobrável, por até R$ 30.990 | G1
articles.standfirst: Modelo entra em pré-venda a partir de 16 de outubro, com entrega e disponibilidade nas lojas a partir de 23 de outubro. Aberto, tem tela de 7,6 polegadas e permite usar dois aplicativos ao mesmo tempo.
articles.summary: Modelo entra em pré-venda a partir de 16 de outubro, com entrega e disponibilidade nas lojas a partir de 23 de outubro.
articles.body:
A Apple apresentou nesta quarta-feira (9) o iPhone Duo, com preços que partem de R$ 21.999 e vão R$ 30.999 , dependendo da capacidade de armazenamento. (veja todos os preços)

O modelo é o primeiro dobrável da Apple e marca a entrada da empresa em um segmento já explorado por concorrentes como Samsung e Huawei.

O iPhone Duo segue a proposta de outros celulares dobráveis: uma tela externa de 5,4 polegadas permite acessar praticamente todos os recursos do iOS sem precisar abrir o aparelho.

Quando aberto, o aparelho revela uma tela de 7,6 polegadas , pouco menor que a de 8,3 polegadas do iPad Mini.

A tela maior amplia a área para assistir a vídeos e oferece recursos extras em aplicativos de terceiros, como o Zoom. Também é possível usar dois aplicativos ao mesmo tempo.

Até a chegada do iPhone Duo, o uso de dois aplicativos ao mesmo tempo era restrito aos iPads entre os dispositivos móveis da Apple. O Duo também é o primeiro iPhone compatível com a Apple Pencil, até então disponível apenas para iPads.

Para reforçar a estrutura do iPhone Duo, a Apple usou titânio na carcaça. Segundo a empresa, uma textura aplicada à tela interna também ajuda a reduzir o vinco comum em celulares dobráveis.

Uma câmera interna, sob a tela, capaz de gravar em Full HD (1080p).

Veja abaixo as imagens do novo iPhone Duo:

Diferentemente dos demais iPhones vendidos atualmente pela Apple, o Duo não tem reconhecimento facial nem entrada para chip físico de operadora — o aparelho utiliza apenas o chip virtual, chamado eSIM.

No lugar do reconhecimento facial, a autenticação biométrica é feita por um leitor de impressões digitais na lateral do aparelho.

A Apple não informa a capacidade da bateria, mas afirma que o aparelho oferece até 24 horas de uso típico. Segundo a empresa, a autonomia pode chegar a 44 horas usando a tela externa e a 31 horas com a tela interna.

Com um carregador de 60 watts ou mais, a bateria pode chegar a 50% da carga em até 20 minutos, segundo a Apple.

O iPhone Duo entra em pré-venda no dia 16 de outubro, e as entregas começam em 23 de outubro.

O iPhone Duo retomou o uso do leitor de impressões digitais (Touch ID) para desbloquear o aparelho. Outros iPhones usam o reconhecimento facial (FaceID). — Foto: Reprodução

Em 2024, o site de tecnologia "The Information" já havia noticiado que a Apple poderia lançar um modelo dobrável em 2026.

Na época, o "The Information" afirmou que a Apple buscava fornecedores na Ásia para fabricar componentes do aparelho e havia dado ao projeto o codinome interno V68.

Relembre as principais mudanças do iPhone desde o lançamento:

2007: Apple lança o primeiro iPhone com tela multitoque;

2008: iPhone 3G chega com conexão 3G e loja de aplicativos, a App Store;

2011: Siri é lançada oficialmente integrada ao iPhone 4S;

2013: sensor de impressão digital (Touch ID) chega ao iPhone 5S;

2017: iPhone ganha carregamento sem fio, a partir do iPhone 8;

2018: iPhone XS Max chega com a maior tela já usada em um iPhone;

2020: Apple retoma design semelhante ao do iPhone 4 no iPhone 12, que também ganha conexão 5G;

2022: iPhone 14 Pro e Pro Max ganham entalhe interativo na tela, chamado de Ilha Dinâmica (Dynamic Island);

2023: iPhone abandona a conexão própria Lightning e ganha USB-C, já presente em aparelhos Android;

2025: iPhone reformula totalmente o design da linha Pro e Pro Max e lança uma nova categoria: o iPhone Air, um smartphone ultrafino.

articles.title: Flávio Bolsonaro não prometeu mínimo de R$ 3 mil; vídeo é IA | G1
articles.standfirst: Ferramentas de detecção apontam uso de IA no conteúdo, que mostra candidato à Presidência segurando peça de picanha. Ao Fato ou Fake, assessoria de imprensa do político confirmou que material é falso.
articles.summary: Ferramentas de detecção Hive Moderation e SynthID apontam que o conteúdo é sintético. Assessoria do candidato aponta que o vídeo é falso.
articles.body:
É #FAKE vídeo em que Flávio Bolsonaro promete salário de R$ 3 mil — Foto: Reprodução

Circula nas redes sociais um vídeo que mostra o candidato à Presidência da República Flávio Bolsonaro ( PL ) aparece com uma peça de picanha da mão e prometendo salário mínimo acima de R$ 3 mil. É #FAKE .

O vídeo foi publicado no TikTok em 28 de julho e mostra Flávio Bolsonaro com uma peça de picanha na mão perto de uma churrasqueira.

Na cena, o candidato aparece dizendo: "Isso aqui é a picanha que a esquerda prometeu. Se você concorda que o salário mínimo tem que ser acima de R$ 3 mil para o povo comprar o que quiser clique em todos os botões ao lado e comenta Brasil 22" .

O Fato ou Fake submeteu o conteúdo a duas ferramentas que detectam conteúdos criados com inteligência artificial (IA) – e ambas apontaram uso desse recurso (veja análises a seguir e infográficos ao final desta checagem) .

Hive Moderation - 99% probabilidade de a cena ser sintética..

Synth ID Detector - "O SynthID foi detectado em todo ou em parte do conteúdo enviado". Essa plataforma identifica materiais gerados especificamente com recursos de IA do Google. A tecnologia insere uma marca d'água imperceptível para humanos (que não conseguem verificar o indicador apenas vendo a imagem). Mas ela é detectável pelo sistema. Diferentemente de outros modelos que geram deepfakes a partir de materiais reais, a IA do Google é capaz de produzir, inclusive, cenas hiper-realistas do zero, ou seja, sem a referência de algo verdadeiro publicado anteriormente.

O Fato ou Fake também entrou em contato com a assessoria de imprensa de Flávio Bolsonaro para questionou se, em algum momento, ele prometeu salário mínimo de R$ 3 mil. A resposta, por e-mail, confirma que "o vídeo é fake". "Montagem clara feita por IA."

articles.title: Sinkhole at Malibu home reportedly owned by Nicolas Cage prompts evacuation
articles.summary: More than 30 properties ordered to evacuate after sinkhole grows to roughly 25-30ft deep and 30 by 60 feet wide
articles.body:
The city of Malibu, California, has ordered the evacuation of more than 30 properties after a large sinkhole opened on Tuesday.

Malibu officials declared a local emergency on Tuesday evening after a "large sinkhole" emerged near 31630 Sea Level Drive. The officials said the sinkhole was believed to have begun developing on Monday, and had grown to roughly 25-30ft deep and 30 by 60ft wide by Tuesday evening.

In an earlier update on Tuesday, officials said they were responding to the "collapse of a driveway" and a resulting gas leak, which had been reported at about 5.45am local time. The Los Angeles county sheriff's department and Los Angeles county fire department closed the private road and identified the gas leak.

Actor Nicolas Cage is reportedly the owner of the home where the sinkhole formed. Cage purchased the home in 2024, the New York Times noted . A representative for Cage did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

"Conditions are continuing to be evaluated, and the full extent of the impacts is not yet known," Malibu city officials said on Tuesday evening, warning that the sinkhole "poses imminent danger to the homes and residents along Sea Level Drive".

By Tuesday evening, 31 properties were under an evacuation order. Officials said that seven homes had been red-tagged because of "hazardous conditions resulting from the sinkhole" while another 24 residences were red-tagged "due to the loss of safe vehicular access". Sheriff's deputies notified residents in person and a digital alert had been issued.

Gas service to the affected area was shut off by Tuesday evening and city officials warned that water service "may also be discontinued as conditions warrant".

They also cautioned that "conditions are likely to worsen with forecasted high tides and rains". Additionally, Post-tropical Cyclone Marie could continue to bring "increased rainfall and high surf" to the area.

The National Weather Service said on Tuesday that "swells generated by Marie will continue to affect portions of the coast of the Baja California Peninsula and southern California for the next couple of days".

A coastal flood advisory had been in effect until 11pm local time on Tuesday, Malibu officials said. A temporary shelter was also established by the American Red Cross at Malibu high school.

City officials said that emergency personnel access "is severely constrained and may be impassable, due to the large portion of the road that has collapsed". They said that as of Tuesday evening, the "intact portion of the roadway is too narrow to accommodate emergency response vehicles, including fire engines and other large apparatus, creating a substantial risk to public safety and emergency response capabilities".

articles.title: Anthropic researcher backs ex-employee’s AI warning, says human extinction could come within years
articles.summary: US News: Hours after Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon resigned from the company warning that the race to develop increasingly powerful AI systems could pose an.
articles.body: Hours after Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon resigned from the company warning that the race to develop increasingly powerful AI systems could pose an existential threat, another researcher at the company has backed his concerns, saying many AI developers believe the technology could potentially cause human extinction within the next few years.Samuel Marks, Anthropic’s scalable-oversight lead, said Coxon’s thread was “very worth reading” while stressing that he was sharing his views in a personal capacity and not speaking for the company.‘AI could cause human extinction’Offering what he described as a “bird’s-eye view” of AI risks, Marks said developers believe advanced AI could result in human extinction or similarly severe outcomes. He added that the level of concern is generally higher among more senior employees in the industry.Marks said AI companies continue developing increasingly capable systems despite these concerns because of commercial incentives and competition. Developers, he said, fear that other companies could build or deploy the technology less safely or potentially misuse it.‘No robust way to align AI yet’Marks also raised concerns about AI alignment, the effort to ensure advanced systems behave in line with human intentions and constraints.“We have methods that can nudge AIs towards better behavior, but nothing that can robustly align them,” Marks said. He suggested that one possible path being considered is developing AI systems capable of helping researchers align their successors more effectively.He further said many AI developers want the industry to slow down and spend more time understanding how to build advanced systems safely. Marks said he had signed an open letter calling for greater caution in frontier AI development.What Evan Hubinger saidAnother Anthropic researcher, Evan Hubinger, also backed Coxon’s warning, saying the industry does not yet have a clear plan to deal with the risks posed by superintelligence.Hubinger, who works in AI alignment, said he personally estimates there is a greater than 10 per cent chance that AI could “kill all humans” within the next decade.He said he believes Anthropic is trying its best, but argued that researchers are “not yet” on track to solve alignment for superintelligence.Hubinger’s comments came in response to Coxon’s resignation and his criticism of Anthropic and OpenAI. Coxon had accused both companies of racing towards self-improving superintelligence despite the potential risks.The comments from the Anthropic researchers come amid growing debate over whether the rapid development of increasingly capable AI systems is moving faster than researchers’ ability to understand and control them.Marks said he works on AI safety because he hopes his research can reduce the possibility of what he described as “extinction-level” outcomes.Catch the latest World News and Live updates. articles.title: In 1978, Massachusetts dumped concrete-filled tyres into the ocean; decades later, they had become a thriving habitat for marine life
articles.summary: US News: A pile of concrete-filled tyres may not look like much from above, but beneath the surface it can become something very different. Off Yarmouth, Massa.
articles.body: A pile of concrete-filled tyres may not look like much from above, but beneath the surface it can become something very different. Off Yarmouth, Massachusetts, the unusual structures form part of an artificial reef that has been developing in Nantucket Sound since 1978. The project was designed to introduce physical complexity to a sandy seabed and provide habitat for fish and lobsters. Over time, the reef expanded to roughly 2,500 original units across 127 acres, while later additions brought in concrete and granite. Surveys in 2019 gave researchers another way to measure its effect, revealing a striking difference in how quickly fish reached structured reef habitat and bare sand.Massachusetts built its first permitted artificial reef with concrete-filled tyresThe Yarmouth reef was developed by the town's Department of Natural Resources with assistance from the Division of Marine Fisheries. It became the first permitted artificial reef of its kind in Massachusetts and was positioned more than two miles south of the mouth of Bass River.The original units were relatively simple. Three to five tyres were filled with concrete and fastened together in bundles, creating a low structure above the seabed. About 1,500 units went into the water in 1978, followed by another 1,000 in 1994, bringing the total to roughly 2,500. The aim was to introduce physical complexity into an otherwise relatively featureless stretch of bottom, giving fish and lobsters places to shelter and move around.Massachusetts' artificial reef programme describes such structures as deliberately placed habitat for fish, with potential benefits for fisheries and recreational fishing.The underwater structures showed little sign of drifting awaySurveys conducted by the Division of Marine Fisheries in 2009 and 2010 used side-scan sonar and divers to examine the site. They found little evidence of reef material moving outside the permitted area. The northern part of the site contained the highest concentration of deployed material, while fish numbers were also higher where more reef structure was present. Scup and black sea bass were among the fish found in substantial numbers.The structures were being managed as habitat. The Massachusetts artificial reef programme uses surveys, diving and remote sensing to track how these sites perform and how marine communities develop around them.The 2019 survey revealed how quickly fish found the reefIn a 2019 survey, researchers compared the Yarmouth reef with another artificial reef, a natural reef and an area of relatively featureless bottom. Underwater video cameras were used to observe fish arriving at the different sites.The contrast was striking in terms of arrival time, without needing a dramatic interpretation. Finfish appeared on camera after an average of about 33 seconds at reef sites, compared with 502 seconds at the bare control. That is roughly eight minutes and 22 seconds over the unstructured seabed. The study calculated that fish appeared on reef sites 93.4% faster than at the bare control.The result did not mean every reef was identical. The study also measured species richness and diversity at Yarmouth, Harwich, a natural reef and the bare control. Black sea bass and scup were among the species recorded across the sites, while the researchers found differences in the composition of fish communities depending on the location and reef age.The tyre bundles created shelter and surfaces for marine lifeThe value of an artificial reef comes partly from the spaces created around and between its structures. A flat sandy bottom offers relatively little vertical relief. Bundled structures create edges, gaps and surfaces where animals can shelter, feed or attach themselves.The Yarmouth site has been associated with a range of marine life, including black sea bass, scup, tautog, summer flounder, winter flounder and lobsters. Other species recorded on the reef include blue mussels, cunner, butterfish, longfin squid and knobbed whelk.The reef therefore became more than a collection of objects placed underwater. Over time, marine organisms colonised the available surfaces, while fish used the added structure as part of the surrounding habitat. Massachusetts' artificial reef planning documents describe earlier monitoring at Yarmouth as showing stabilisation of the structures, colonisation by marine organisms and increased recreational fishing activity.New structures continued to reshape the Yarmouth reefThe original 1978 deployment was not the end of the project. In 2014, the town and the Division of Marine Fisheries received permits to add further reef material in parts of the site where surveys had identified lower concentrations of existing structures.More material was added again around 2019 and early 2020. This included retired concrete buoy sinkers from the US Coast Guard, granite blocks recovered from demolition projects and other concrete material. More than 3,000 cubic yards of new material were involved across the two deployment efforts.The later additions also changed the character of the reef. Rather than relying only on the original tyre bundles, the site began incorporating approved construction and infrastructure materials that could provide similar physical relief. articles.title: In 2020, Kesha bought a Los Angeles mansion for $4.95 million; after a $5.95 million listing and $7 million relisting, it sold for $6.68 million, $1.73 million above her purchase price
articles.summary: News News: Kesha has sold her sprawling Los Angeles mansion for $6.68 million, nearly two years after she first attempted to offload the property. The sale gives.
articles.body: Kesha has sold her sprawling Los Angeles mansion for $6.68 million, nearly two years after she first attempted to offload the property. The sale gives the pop star a profit of almost $1.7 million on the Mar Vista home, which she purchased in 2020 for $4.95 million.The 39-year-old singer, whose full name is Kesha Rose Sebert, first listed the ultramodern property in March 2024 for $5.95 million. She had bought the home just four years earlier, paying $4.95 million for the contemporary residence.The listing was pulled from the market within weeks. Kesha returned with the property in March this year, this time setting a considerably higher asking price of $7 million. The mansion was also offered as a rental, with a monthly asking price of $35,000.According to property records by Realtor, the home eventually found a buyer, with the transaction closing on May 19 for $6.68 million. While the final figure fell short of Kesha's $7 million asking price, it represents a sizeable gain over her original purchase price.The singer stands to make just under $1.7 million on paper from the sale, before taxes, commissions and other transaction-related expenses.Inside Kesha's sprawling Mar Vista propertySet in the upscale Los Angeles neighborhood of Mar Vista, the seven-bedroom, eight-bathroom home was conceived by local architecture and landscaping firm OTT Arch. The design is built around the idea of blurring the boundaries between the house and its outdoor surroundings.Large sliding glass doors on the main level open directly onto the backyard, where a pool and patio create an extension of the living space. Multiple decks are positioned across the home's various levels, with several bedrooms offering direct outdoor access.Built in 2018, the main residence spans just under 6,000 square feet and combines sharp contemporary architecture with warmer wooden details. A dramatic staircase with glass railings serves as one of the property's focal points, while a glass-enclosed wine storage area adds another distinctive touch.The open-plan main living area connects the living room, dining space and kitchen. The latter features a 14-foot island, quartz countertops and high-end appliances. Wide-plank hardwood flooring and expansive windows help bring natural light into the interiors.Property includes separate two-bedroom guest houseOne of the property's more notable features is a separate accessory dwelling unit measuring approximately 1,000 square feet.The guest house includes two bedrooms, a private kitchen, two bathrooms and its own laundry facilities, making it suitable for extended guests or additional household staff.The outdoor amenities are equally substantial. The estate comes with a 40-foot swimming pool, spa and built-in barbecue station, while the multi-level rooftop deck offers 360-degree views of the surrounding area. A fire pit and multiple seating areas turn the rooftop into another entertainment zone.Kesha brought her personality into the modern interiorsDespite the home's distinctly contemporary architecture, Kesha's interiors were considerably more eclectic. Listing photographs taken during her ownership showed colorful rugs, artwork and layered textures that softened the property's minimalist lines.A den featured a built-in fireplace alongside vibrant furnishings and artwork, while the adjoining dining area opened toward the kitchen. A second living room provided another informal gathering space.The singer's primary bedroom was dominated by a California king-sized bed, with décor that nodded to her music career and distinctive personal style. Among the more unusual touches was a mannequin dressed in a studded leather jacket.Her fashion sensibility was also apparent in the expansive walk-in closet, which featured three storage islands and ample room for her wardrobe.Elsewhere, Kesha had turned one of the bedrooms into a music room, complete with a keyboard, drum kit and patterned sofa. Another room was dedicated to fitness and wellness and included workout equipment and a home sauna.Kesha hints at a move to San FranciscoThe sale of Kesha's Los Angeles home comes as the singer appears to be contemplating a move north.During a surprise DJ set in San Francisco earlier this month, Kesha told the crowd, "I'm moving to San Francisco." Whether she has already purchased a home in the city remains unclear.Her apparent relocation plans come at a significant point in her career. The mansion sale was completed just days before the launch of her Freedom Tour, which begins on May 23.Kesha announced the tour on March 24, framing it as a celebration of reclaiming her voice, body and joy after years of personal and professional upheaval."This summer we are reclaiming our bodies, our voices, and our joy. We have survived. Now we get to be free. Let’s be free together. I want to know what freedom feels like, with all of you," she said at the time.She later described the tour as a reflection of what comes after surviving difficult experiences, saying she had "lived through the fire" and that freedom was about discovering how those experiences had shaped her.Ready to Make a Smarter Property Decision? articles.title: Chen Ziyi cause of death: What happened to Chinese mukbang streamer who died at 24?
articles.summary: US Streamers News: Chinese mukbang creator Chen Ziyi, known online as Ganfan Yingying, died on August 17, 2026, at the age of 24. Her parents confirmed her death, accord.
articles.body: Chinese mukbang creator Chen Ziyi, known online as Ganfan Yingying, died on August 17, 2026, at the age of 24. Her parents confirmed her death, according to Global Times and other Chinese media reports. The news came only days after Chen revealed that she had been hospitalized after her blood potassium level dropped to 2.3 mmol/L. Her family did not announce an official cause of death, although some reports raised cardiac arrest as a possible explanation.Who was Chen Ziyi, the mukbang star known as Ganfan Yingying?Chen became known in China for her mukbang videos, a form of online content where creators eat large amounts of food while interacting with viewers. The format became popular in South Korea before spreading around the world.Chen built a large following through her extreme eating videos. VnExpress reported that she had about 1.2 million followers across her social media accounts. Her online name, Ganfan Yingying, became closely linked to the food videos that helped her gain an audience.But her content also came with serious pressure. Chen had previously spoken about the difficulty of eating very large amounts of food for videos while trying to control her weight.That issue became especially clear in her final videos. On August 14, Chen told followers that she had been hospitalized because her potassium level had fallen to 2.3 mmol/L. The normal blood potassium range is generally around 3.5 to 5.0 mmol/L, although exact reference ranges can vary between laboratories.Chen also acknowledged that she would sometimes make herself vomit after eating large amounts of food in an effort to avoid gaining weight. Repeated vomiting can cause the body to lose potassium and can lead to hypokalemia, or dangerously low potassium levels.In the video, Chen urged her followers to take their health seriously. She said, “Although making money is important, health should always come first.” Her comments were particularly striking because they came just days before her death.What happened to Chen Ziyi before her death?Chen’s parents confirmed that she died on August 17, 2026, but they did not publicly give a specific medical cause. VnExpress also reported that her family had not disclosed the exact reason for her death.That distinction matters because some reports have linked her death to cardiac arrest caused by her very low potassium level. Global Times discussed that possibility, but it was not confirmed by Chen’s family as the official cause of death.Very low potassium can be dangerous because potassium plays an important role in the normal function of muscles and the heart. Severe hypokalemia can cause abnormal heart rhythms and, in serious cases, can become life-threatening. Repeated vomiting is one known way the body can lose large amounts of potassium.Chen’s death has therefore raised fresh questions about the health risks faced by creators who make extreme eating content. Her final warning also showed that she was aware of the toll the work could take on her body.Chen was not the only mukbang creator to face serious health problems connected to extreme eating. Chinese creator Pan Xiaoting died in 2024 after reportedly developing health problems following extreme eating livestreams. Her death also led to wider discussion about the risks of turning excessive food consumption into online entertainment.For Chen’s followers, however, the most important part of her final message was simple: the money and attention from online content should not come before a person’s health.Catch the latest World News and Live updates. articles.title: In 1807, pigs were released on New Zealand's Auckland Islands as food for castaways; 192 years later, 17 were rescued before the feral population was eradicated
articles.summary: Rest of World News: On a remote, windswept archipelago far south of New Zealand, a small herd of pigs lived out more than two centuries as one of the world’s most isolate.
articles.body: On a remote, windswept archipelago far south of New Zealand, a small herd of pigs lived out more than two centuries as one of the world’s most isolated feral populations. Their ancestors were left on the Auckland Islands in 1807, released by sailors as a living food store for any shipwrecked castaways who might one day wash up on those storm-battered shores. For 192 years, the pigs roamed the subantarctic forests and bogs, adapting to a harsh climate and becoming a unique genetic lineage known as the Auckland Island pig. In the early 2000s, as part of a major conservation effort to restore the islands, the decision was made to eradicate all feral pigs. Before that work began, 17 individuals were captured and brought back to the mainland to preserve the breed. As documented by the Rare Breeds Trust of New Zealand, their rescue marked the end of one chapter and the uncertain beginning of another for these living relics of maritime history.A gift for shipwrecked sailorsThe story begins in the age of sailing ships, when the Southern Ocean was a dangerous highway for vessels rounding the bottom of the world. The Auckland Islands, a rugged group of volcanic islands about 450 kilometres south of New Zealand’s South Island, were notorious for their ferocious weather, steep cliffs and dense, tangled vegetation. Many ships were lost in these waters, and those who survived the wrecks faced a grim struggle to stay alive on the barren shores.In 1807, a group of sealers or sailors, accounts vary, released a small number of domestic pigs on the largest of the Auckland Islands. The idea was simple and practical. If future castaways found themselves stranded, they would at least have a source of meat that could breed and sustain itself without human care. The pigs were hardy, able to forage in forest and scrub, and they quickly adapted to the cool, wet conditions of the subantarctic. Over the decades, more pigs may have been added by other visitors, but the core population descended from those original animals. With no natural predators and plenty of plant food, along with the occasional seabird or invertebrate, the herd grew and spread across the main island and some smaller ones nearby.Life on a subantarctic islandThe Auckland Islands are a world apart from the farms and pastures where domestic pigs usually live. The climate is cool and wet year-round, with frequent gales and dense cloud. The landscape is a mosaic of stunted forests, fern lands, peat bogs and rocky coastlines. Food is available, but it is scattered and seasonal, and the pigs had to range widely to find enough to eat.Over 192 years, the pigs evolved into a distinct type. They were generally smaller than modern farm breeds, with thick coats of dark hair, strong legs and tough hooves suited to boggy ground. They were extremely hardy, able to survive on a diet of roots, shoots, fungi, carrion and whatever else they could dig up in the forest floor. Their behaviour was wary and elusive, shaped by centuries of avoiding human contact in an environment where people were rare but sometimes dangerous. To conservationists and historians, these animals became more than just feral livestock. They were living links to the early days of European exploration and sealing in the Southern Ocean, a rare example of an old domestic breed surviving in near-wild conditions with little to no crossbreeding from modern pigs.A conflict between heritage and conservationBy the late 20th century, the value of the Auckland Islands had shifted in the eyes of scientists and policymakers. Once seen mainly as a remote outpost on a shipping route, the archipelago was now recognised as a globally important nature reserve. It is home to unique plants, seabirds and marine mammals, many of which are found nowhere else. Several species of albatross, penguin and petrel nest on the islands, and the surrounding waters are rich in marine life.From this new perspective, the feral pigs were a problem. They disturbed nesting birds, competed for food with other wildlife and added to erosion on fragile soils. New Zealand has a strong conservation ethic and a policy of removing introduced mammals from its offshore islands in an effort to protect native ecosystems. The pigs, despite their historic interest, were classified as an invasive species that needed to be eradicated. This created an uncomfortable tension. On one side was the ecological argument for removing the pigs to allow the native flora and fauna to recover. On the other stood the historical and genetic value of a unique pig lineage that had survived in isolation for nearly two centuries. For many, it was painful to think of wiping out an entire population that was itself a kind of living heritage.The decision to rescue a fewIn the end, a compromise was reached. Conservation authorities decided that the feral pig population on the Auckland Islands would be removed to protect the islands’ natural values, but that a small number of animals would be captured beforehand and brought to the mainland to preserve the breed. This approach is common in New Zealand conservation work, where rare or historically significant introduced species are sometimes rescued before eradication campaigns begin. In the early 2000s, teams visited the islands to trap and capture pigs. The work was challenging. The animals were wary, the terrain was difficult, and the weather was often harsh. Even so, they managed to secure 17 individuals, a mix of males and females representing different family lines within the population. These 17 became the founding stock of the mainland conservation programme for Auckland Island pigs. Once the rescue was complete, the remaining pigs on the islands were systematically removed. By the time the eradication was declared successful, no feral pigs were left on the Auckland Islands. The landscape began to change almost immediately, with native plants regenerating in areas that had been heavily rooted and new opportunities for nesting birds to reclaim former pig habitat.A new life on the mainlandBack on the New Zealand mainland, the 17 rescued pigs faced a very different world. They were placed in secure farm settings where they could be monitored, bred and cared for without the risk of escaping and becoming a pest. The goal was not to turn them into a commercial breed, but to maintain them as a genetic reservoir and a living historical resource.The Auckland Island pig is now classified as a rare breed. It is valued for its hardiness, disease resistance and ability to thrive on rough forage, traits that are of interest to smallholders and conservation-minded farmers. Some owners keep them in semi-natural conditions to preserve their wilder behaviour and physical characteristics. Others use them in crossbreeding programmes to introduce resilience into other lines, though purebred breeding is encouraged to maintain the integrity of the original stock. For the Rare Breeds Trust and similar groups, the pigs are more than livestock. They are a tangible connection to the maritime past, to the era when ships sailed the Southern Ocean with minimal support and when castaway depots and live food stores were part of survival planning. Each animal carries in its genes the story of 192 years of isolation on a remote island.What the story reveals about humans and natureThe odyssey of the Auckland Island pigs, from abandoned food source to protected rare breed, reflects larger shifts in attitudes to islands, wildlife and conservation. In the 19th Century, bringing pigs to a deserted island for future shipwreck survivors was a perfectly reasonable thing to do. Human safety and utility were the priorities and little consideration was given to long-term ecological consequences. By the 21st century, the focus had changed. The intrinsic value of native ecosystems and the rights of indigenous species to exist free from the interference of introduced mammals took precedence. Once a useful resource, the pigs were reclassified as a threat to biodiversity. But their historical and genetic significance was not forgotten. The decision to save a few before they are wiped out suggests a more complex view, one that seeks to balance ecological restoration with a reverence for living history. Today, the Auckland Island pigs that remain on the mainland are a reminder of how human actions ripple through time. A decision made in 1807 to release a few pigs on a distant island shaped an entire population for nearly two centuries. A later decision to remove them reshaped the islands’ ecology and gave the breed a second chance in a very different setting.A future that remains uncertainThe long term future of the Auckland Island pig as a distinct breed is not guaranteed. Numbers are still relatively small, and maintaining genetic diversity requires careful breeding management. Interest from farmers and hobbyists can wax and wane, and without a clear economic role, the pigs depend largely on the dedication of a small community of supporters.Even so, their survival on the mainland ensures that the story of the Auckland Islands’ feral pigs does not end with their eradication from the archipelago. They continue to roam pastures far from the subantarctic winds, carrying in their DNA the memory of a harsh and remote island where their ancestors once lived as the only large land mammals for nearly 200 years.Catch the latest World News and Live updates. articles.body: An OPT student has shared the questions they faced from an immigration officer when a friend's group went to New Mexico for the long weekend earlier this month. The student said the group consisted of OPT and STEM-OPT students, all based in Dallas. They were asked to show their I-20, the official document issued by a US school or university to an international student who has been admitted to an F-1 program; OPT card and other documents."My OPT was recently approved but I haven't received the physical card yet. The officer asked me to open the USCIS portal and show the approval. After about 30 minutes, they left," the post said."Two of my friends are working, and the officer asked them to show their office Outlook or Teams to prove that they are currently working. I did not carry a physical copy of my I-20. The officer told me that this was a serious issue and that it could be considered a crime. They asked us many questions about our college and other details," the student wrote, adding that foreign students must carry all immigration documents, I-20, OPT card, passport with a copy of visa when they are traveling even to a neighboring state.Social media users said that this is a common practice near the Mexican or Canadian border. "Yes this pretty common in New Mexico as it’s a place where lot of research is made. And it’s very close to the border so be prepared for any such checks," one wrote. "If you visit any city with 100 miles of Mexican or Canadian border, be prepared to show documents. Nothing new in this," another wrote.The post came as the administration is cracking down on OPT abuse and stopping it from becoming a pipeline for H-1B. articles.body: N3on and Sneako have turned a disagreement over artificial intelligence into a very public fight. The clash started after N3on announced an AI version of himself that could keep streaming on Kick while he was asleep or away. Sneako strongly criticized the idea and questioned why N3on needed another way to make money. N3on then accused Sneako of being disloyal for discussing the issue publicly instead of speaking to him in private. The argument later became personal, with both streamers trading harsh comments about each other online and on livestreams.N3on’s AI stream brings criticism from SneakoN3on announced the project on September 7, 2026, saying he was becoming the “first AI streamer in the world.” He also wrote, “This is my last stream as a human being,” while saying the broadcast would never end. The project was presented as being powered by GPT-6 Astra and Higgsfield AI and was set to run on Kick.Sneako did not like the idea. He questioned whether N3on needed the extra income and brought up his gambling deals while criticizing the AI project. His comments were blunt and quickly pushed the disagreement beyond the technology itself.“Yeah, N3on, this **** is ing rded. Do you not make enough money from all the gambling deals you take already? It gets to a point. What is this for? Is it for clout? So that [people] go, 'Oh my God, he's the first AI streamer.' What, you're the first one to start the domino effect to ruin streaming and brain-rot the world even more?”N3on’s problem was less about the criticism and more about the way Sneako delivered it. He said a friend should have called or texted him instead of turning the disagreement into a public rant.“Why would you say that about your friend and go on a rant for 45 minutes? Tell me this in private and move on, dumb****. He's the most [disloyal] guy I've ever seen in my life. Literally. It's cool that we've known Sneako is like that. This isn't anything new.”Sneako and N3on take the fight beyond AIThe argument soon became more personal. During a collaboration with The Orthodox Muslim, Sneako questioned how seriously people viewed N3on.“If we're being real, people don't consider you to be a man. So you could talk this way, and you seem like a dumb little kid. He's the same age as [The Orthodox Muslim]. You don't speak to men like this. You get away with it because, deep down, you know people don't take you seriously. You're just a yapping little boy.”N3on fired back by accusing Sneako of caring more about views than their friendship.“Sneako, **** yourself. You're a piece of ****. You'll do anything for views. You'll use religion for views. If you cared about me, you would text me, you would call me, you would talk to me, not make it public.”N3on later said the AI idea itself was “cool and interesting,” but again attacked Sneako for criticizing him publicly.“It was cool and interesting. **** off, **** Sneako... No matter what you think about your friends, if they're truly your friends and you value and care for them, then no matter what it is, you would never bash them online. You're a fake ****. You are.”Sneakoe then added another jab on X, writing, “Sorry, wish I could make the funeral but just can't miss the 24/7 AI n3on subathon stream.”Catch the latest World News and Live updates. articles.title: NC tells Congress: Full Vande Mataram a constitutional duty
articles.summary: India News: SRINAGAR: National Conference fired a political broadside at ally Congress Wednesday, defending full renditions of Vande Mataram at govt functions in .
articles.body: SRINAGAR: National Conference fired a political broadside at ally Congress Wednesday, defending full renditions of Vande Mataram at govt functions in J&K as a “constitutional” duty.Congress objected after all six stanzas of the national song was played at the inauguration of J&K’s first international film festival in Srinagar attended by CM Omar Abdullah and NC president Farooq Abdullah on Sept 7. As at other official functions, Omar stood at attention throughout.J&K Congress president Tariq Hamid Karra said NC and Congress should respect how the song’s place in India’s national life evolved through both the freedom movement and constitutional journey. “National symbols, songs and traditions occupy a special place in the heart of every Indian. Their true strength lies in their ability to bind together a nation as diverse as ours,” he said, calling it a concern that alliance partners had chosen to sing the full version.NC countered, asking Congress to look at CMs of states governed by the party, including Telangana and Karnataka, who have participated in full renditions.NC chief spokesperson Tanvir Sadiq shared on X a video featuring Karnataka CM DK Shivakumar at an event where the unabridged song was sung. He said govt protocol must be separated from party ideology. “NC has a clear stand. When Parliament has adopted it, playing Vande Mataram becomes a statutory obligation and that is what govt did,” Sadiq said. CM Omar later shared Sadiq’s statements on X.A Union home ministry protocol directive in Feb mandated the six-stanza version of the song at all state functions, official events and legislature sessions. In Aug, the President cleared Prevention of Insults to National Honour (Amendment) Act, which puts Vande Mataram on a par with the national anthem, making disrespect/disruption a punishable offence. The amended law did not change the stanzas, but people are now obligated to respect Vande Mataram as a constitutional duty.NC spokesperson Imran Nabi Dar said: “This is a constitutional obligation, and every one holding a constitutional office has to accept it, whether it is the CM, an MP or anyone else,” he said, adding the full version is now regularly played at govt functions across J&K.Dar acknowledged the objection among Muslims. “Though religiously it is not acceptable to Muslims, it is a constitutional obligation that has to be fulfilled,” he said.The freedom movement broadly adopted first two stanzas of Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay’s 1875 poem, while the full song has six containing religious imagery that has drawn objections from Muslims. Congress general secretary GA Mir said freedom fighters had shaped the version used by the movement with inclusivity in mind.(inputs from PTI)Get the latest India News and Live updates. articles.title: Several killed in Russian attacks on Ukraine as Siberian gas plant hit
articles.summary: Several people have been killed and dozens injured in Russian attacks across Ukraine on Wednesday. In Kiev, a woman was killed when a combat drone struck a m...
articles.body:
Multiple people killed and dozens injured in Russian attacks across Ukraine, including in Kiev, Mykolaiv, Kramatorsk, and Sumy.

Russian Defence Ministry confirms attacks using drones and precision-guided weapons, targeting military depots, but independent verification of reports not initially possible.

Ukrainian armed forces reportedly attack gas plant in Siberia using drones, with unverifiable photos published by Ukrainian media and confirmation of attack by local governor.

Several people have been killed and dozens injured in Russian attacks across Ukraine on Wednesday.

In Kiev, a woman was killed when a combat drone struck a multi-storey residential building. Three other residents, including children, were injured, according to the civil defence authorities.

Mayor Vitali Klitschko said that a total of 16 people were injured in Russian attacks on the Ukrainian capital over the course of the day.

In the port city of Mykolaiv, at least two people were killed, and a further twelve injured in repeated Russian attacks.

The attacks targeted port facilities and warehouses where food is stored, officials said.

The Russian Defence Ministry confirmed the attacks using drones and precision-guided weapons, but stated that only military depots were targeted and hit. It was not initially possible to independently verify the reports.

At least nine residents were injured in a Russian airstrike on the town of Kramatorsk in eastern Ukraine.

The authorities reported that the town was hit by at least nine glide bombs.

In Sumy, in eastern Ukraine, three people were killed when a drone struck the car park of a shopping centre. A further 14 people were injured, according to a statement by the acting mayor, Artem Kobzar, on Telegram.

"The enemy carried out a treacherous attack at precisely the moment when the town's residents were on their way home from work to go shopping," the city's military administrator, Serhiy Kryvosheienko, wrote on Telegram.

The shopping centre was damaged, and numerous cars caught fire.

Reports: Ukraine hits gas plant in Siberia

According to media reports, the Ukrainian armed forces attacked and possibly damaged a distant target in Siberia using drones.

Ukrainian media reported that a gas condensation plant was attacked in Novy Urengoy, in the Yamal-Nenets Autonomous Okrug of western Siberia.

There were no officially confirmed details regarding the extent of the damage. The Ukrainian news agency UNIAN published unverifiable photos from Russian social media.

The governor of the district, Dmitry Artyukhov, confirmed the attack by combat drones and spoke of a fire caused by falling debris. According to his account, the approaching drones were shot down. "The situation is under control," he wrote.

Novy Urengoy is over 3,000 kilometres from the Ukrainian border. The company that was attacked is considered one of the region's most important gas infrastructure facilities.

For months, Ukraine has been attacking industrial and defence facilities, as well as refineries, on Russian territory in order to weaken the Russian military.

Kiev has developed long-range combat drones capable of striking targets several thousand kilometres away.

articles.title: Zelenskyy's plane nearly hit by drone while taking off from Moldova: Norway PM
articles.summary: Europe News: A plane carrying Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy narrowly avoided a collision with an unidentified drone while taking off from Moldova en rout.
articles.body: A plane carrying Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy narrowly avoided a collision with an unidentified drone while taking off from Moldova en route to Oslo for the funeral of King Harald V.Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Store confirmed the incident in an interview with public broadcaster NRK on Wednesday, highlighting the security risks surrounding the Ukrainian leader's movements.“His plane was almost hit by a drone as it was taking off from Moldova. That is the reality he is facing,” PM told NRK.The incident has not yet been confirmed by Ukrainian authorities.Zelenskyy safely arrived in Oslo on Tuesday evening after departing Moldova to attend the royal funeral service alongside world leaders and international dignitaries. He had earlier met Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre.Providing further details, State Secretary Bhanuja Rasiah at the Prime Minister's Office told NRK that the airspace threat affected the Ukrainian president's flight schedule."There was a drone threat in the airspace over Moldova yesterday, which delayed Zelenskyy's flight on its way to Oslo. These are threats he lives with every day. It is uncertain how close the drones were to his plane." NRK cited him as saying.Norwegian finance minister Jens Stoltenberg also confirmed that Zelenskyy personally recounted the incident shortly after arriving in the Norwegian capital."He told us about it last night when we had a meeting with him. I don't dare go into the details about it, but he was delayed, and there were some threats against the plane. But I don't know enough about the details to explain anything more," Stoltenberg said."There were some problems getting out, but it's never easy to get out of Ukraine. But the most important thing was that he took the time, the effort it took for him to come to the funeral," he added.Despite the security risks during the journey, Stoltenberg said Zelenskyy's presence at the funeral was significant. He noted that it was impressive to see the Ukrainian president walking alongside other world leaders during King Harald's funeral on Wednesday, NRK reported.Following his attendance at the funeral, Zelenskyy paid tribute to the late monarch in a post on X."We paid our respects to King Harald V. Ukraine will always be grateful to Norway for all its assistance. This support comes not only from the government, but also from the Royal Family and all the people of Norway. I recall with gratitude our warm meeting with His Majesty and the special attention he paid to Ukraine. He was a monarch who, for over 35 years, embodied Norway – its openness, dignity, and respect for people. Over that time, our bond with Norway has grown especially strong."Zelenskyy also expressed gratitude for Norway's continued support for Ukraine amid the ongoing conflict."We are grateful that Norway has stood with Ukraine all these years. Thank you for the decisions that are helping us protect people and stand firm today."Meanwhile, Zelenskyy said Ukrainian defence forces had carried out successful long-range strikes against a major Russian naval base, as Russian drone and missile attacks killed and wounded civilians across several Ukrainian cities.In another post on X, Zelenskyy said Ukrainian forces had struck key targets deep inside Russian territory, including the Black Sea port of Novorossiysk in the Krasnodar region.The strikes against Russian infrastructure came as emergency crews were deployed across Ukraine following another wave of deadly Russian drone attacks targeting civilian infrastructure.Zelenskyy said Russian strikes in Sumy, Kyiv and Mykolaiv had killed several people and left others seriously injured.Calling on international partners to increase their support to help end the escalation, he wrote, “Right now, it is important for all partners to focus as much as possible and work on the relevant steps toward de-escalation and an end to the killing,”Zelenskyy said he had discussed the situation with representatives of US President Donald Trump's team as well as European leaders.His remarks came after talks in Kyiv with US special envoy Steve Witkoff and Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner.Zelenskyy said three rounds of discussions with the US delegation had taken place and described them as substantive, expressing hope that the talks would help revive negotiations and lead to a lasting peace agreement.Earlier, Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov said Russia welcomed US President Donald Trump's efforts to bring peace to the region.With Russia continuing its strikes and diplomatic efforts yet to yield a breakthrough, a lasting peace agreement remains elusive.Catch the latest World News and Live updates.
